import win32com.client
import pythoncom

pythoncom.CoInitialize()

# Connect to Nanosurf AFM
afm = win32com.client.Dispatch('Nanosurf.EasyScan2')

# Set PID gains for optimal feedback control
# These values provide stable feedback while minimizing tip damage
afm.PGain = 100
afm.IGain = 6000
afm.DGain = 10

# Set scanning parameters
# Time per line of 0.1s provides slower, gentler scanning
# 128 lines per frame gives good resolution
afm.TimePerLine = 0.1
afm.LinesPerFrame = 128

print(f'PID Gains set: P={afm.PGain}, I={afm.IGain}, D={afm.DGain}')
print(f'Scanning parameters: Time per Line={afm.TimePerLine}s, Lines per Frame={afm.LinesPerFrame}')
print('Configuration complete - optimized for minimal tip damage')
</final_answer>
